item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will bring persistently very hot and fine weather to southern China this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Winds will be weak over the coastal areas early next week, and showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nanmadol will move across the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Muifa will move across the coastal areas of eastern China and weaken gradually today and tomorrow.
